I have farmed this land for many years and I know what works for my family. I will apply some chemical fertilizer because the extension workers say it helps maize grow strong, and I was able to get a small bag from the cooperative. I will also spread cow manure on this plot because we have animals at home and it makes the soil fertile. For seed, I will plant the improved maize from the market — it yields better than our old local seed. I do not have money for pesticides or herbicides, and there is no water for irrigation here, so my children and I will pull the weeds by hand and depend entirely on the rains. This plot is small, only about half a timad, so my family can manage all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves without hiring anyone.
